address: GF, Kronos Sathorn Building, 46 North Sathorn Road, Si Lom, Bang Rak, Bangkok, 10500, Thailand
bio: Saryu, a name that symbolises the precious passing of time, is set behind a discreet wooden door that leads into a lounge-cum-cave. The minimalist dining area sports a traditional omakase counter made out of Hinoki wood. Chef Seiji Sudo meticulously crafts a 15-course omakase menu based on seafood sourced directly from Tokyo’s Toyosu Fish Market. With a mere 6 seats available daily (or 8 for private groups), reservations are essential....
